summary.text: Judith García is a Democratic state representative from the 11th Suffolk District who has held the seat since January 4, 2023 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026. She previously served on the Chelsea City Council.

paragraphs.text: Judith García earned a B.A. in urban studies/affairs from Wheaton College Massachusetts and worked as the communications manager of The Neighborhood Developers.
She has served on the Chelsea City Council, on the board of HarborCOV, and as a U.S. delegate to Russia with the American Council of Young Political Leaders.
García succeeded Elizabeth Malia in the House seat in 2023.

In the 2025-2026 session she serves on House Ways and Means, the Education Joint Committee and the Health Care Financing Joint Committee, and is vice chair of the Children, Families and Persons with Disabilities Joint Committee.
